rdfs:label: streams
rdfs:comment: Supplementary Collections that an actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service) exposes in ActivityPub beyond the standard inbox/outbox/followers/following — extension points for application-specific feeds.
notes: An open-ended list of Collections — bookmarks, drafts, an alternate-channel outbox, anything the application needs. ActivityPub only describes it as "a list of supplementary Collections which may be of interest" and defines no standard labels; in practice the property is rarely used.

history.note: Removed invented SHOULD requirements from notes; dropped non-existent Actor class domain/seeAlso.
